# has creation event

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasCreationEvent`](gmeow-hasCreationEvent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasCreationEvent>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lifecycle`](../../slices/lifecycle.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Links an entity to the event that brought it into existence — the general form of birth (person), founding (organization), minting (currency), or realization (reference frame). Non-functional: competing standpoint-indexed creation claims coexist, none privileged. A [`Person`](../classes/gmeow-Person.md)'s birth event is ALSO typed [`gmeow:eventTypeBirth`](../individuals/gmeow-eventTypeBirth.md) (co-equal value, not a subclass).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) -> [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasCreationEvent`](gmeow-hasCreationEvent.md) from [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) to [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Dissolved Org

- **Source:** [`slices/core/lifecycle/examples/dissolved-org.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/lifecycle/examples/dissolved-org.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-lifecycle-examples-dissolved-org)#example-slices-core-lifecycle-examples-dissolved-org

```turtle
# --- The dissolved company: still here, with its full lifecycle attached.
#     Superseded AND no longer extant, so gmeow:displayable false suppresses it
#     from default display — the record is retained, never deleted (P10).
ex:meridian a gmeow:Organization ;
    gmeow:name "Meridian Systems Ltd."@en ;
    gmeow:hasCreationEvent ex:founding ;
    gmeow:hasDestructionEvent ex:dissolution ;
    gmeow:existenceInterval ex:meridianLife ;
    gmeow:supersededBy ex:apex ;
    gmeow:displayable false .

# --- The successor, still extant, that superseded Meridian.
ex:apex a gmeow:Organization ;
    gmeow:name "Apex Systems Inc."@en ;
    gmeow:hasCreationEvent ex:apexFounding .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the flat 80% case — linking any entity to the event that brought it into existence (birth, founding, minting, realization) without reifying the existence claim.

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the creation claim is itself contested, needs evidence, or must be standpoint-indexed (promote to [`gmeow:EntityExistence`](../classes/gmeow-EntityExistence.md) with [`gmeow:existenceCreationEvent`](gmeow-existenceCreationEvent.md)) and avoid forcing one event — keep it non-functional so competing claims coexist.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:hasCreationEvent`](gmeow-hasCreationEvent.md) from the entity to a [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) and co-type that event with the right [`EventType`](../classes/gmeow-EventType.md) value ([`gmeow:eventTypeBirth`](../individuals/gmeow-eventTypeBirth.md), founding, …); reify to [`gmeow:EntityExistence`](../classes/gmeow-EntityExistence.md) only when the claim itself needs standpoint or evidence.

### Examples

- ex:lillith [`gmeow:hasCreationEvent`](gmeow-hasCreationEvent.md) ex:lillithBirth. ex:lillithBirth a [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md); gmeow:hasEventType [`gmeow:eventTypeBirth`](../individuals/gmeow-eventTypeBirth.md).
